verdict.rationale: 1Password documents its own export feature for moving data to a different app, and it stores one-time passwords. However, the evidence never states that the export includes TOTP secrets, and never names an open, readable export format. Missing for 10: confirmation that TOTP seeds are included in exports, a documented open/readable export format (e.g. CSV or otpauth URIs), and independent or hands-on corroboration of a clean migration to another app.

support.subject: As a power user, I can export all my TOTP secrets in an open, readable format and leave for another app whenever I choose — no lock-in

citations.quote: You can export your information from the 1Password apps if you want to move it to a different app.
Learn how to use 1Password to store and quickly access your one-time passwords when you turn on two-step verification for a website.
